message.reasoning:
The user asks: "找出1980年和2016年美國的總統是誰，以及1975年和2011年的副總統是誰。" They want the presidents in 1980 and 2016, and vice presidents in 1975 and 2011. We need to use the function get_president_and_vp. We need to call it twice for presidents: year 1980, position 'president'; year 2016, position 'president'. And twice for vice presidents: year 1975, position 'vice president'; year 2011, position 'vice president'.

We should call the function for each. The function returns data. We need to combine results. The user likely expects a concise answer: 1980 president: Jimmy Carter? Wait, 1980: Carter was president until Jan 20, 1981. So in 1980, the president was Jimmy Carter. 2016: President was Barack Obama until Jan 20, 2017. So 2016 president: Barack Obama. Vice presidents: 1975: Gerald Ford was VP until 1973? Wait, 1975: Vice President was Gerald Ford? Actually Gerald Ford became VP in 1973 after Nixon's resignation, then became president in 1974. So in 1975, the Vice President was... After Ford became president, the VP position was vacant until 1977 when Nelson Rockefeller was appointed. So in 1975, there was no Vice President. But maybe the function will return something. 2011: Vice President was Joe Biden (since 2009). So answer: 1980: Jimmy Carter; 2016: Barack Obama; 1975: None; 2011: Joe Biden.
